title: Native Pi message, with optional first-message-only model intent
description: Body of send, steer and follow_up. reply_to (reply-to-message, experimental) answers one agent message on the conversation's current branch: the daemon reads that message's excerpt from the native session and prepends it as a <reply-to> block. It is refused with 400 invalid_request while the person's experimental switch is off or before a slash command, and with 409 reply_target_gone, before anything reaches Pi, when the entry is not an assistant message with text on the current branch.
